distilled_rules.use_case: Filter trading to this vol-bucket × trend combination; mute the model elsewhere.

distilled_rules.use_case: Use confidence as a position-size multiplier; mute conf 1-2 trades entirely; size up only on conf=5 directional calls.

distilled_rules.rule: FLAT predictions (N=71) split: 33 up, 34 down, 4 flat. The directional split is ~50/50 — the model honestly admits 'I don't know'.

distilled_rules.rule: When System A and System B agree on a directional call (non-flat), accuracy is 0.500 (N=12).
